{{Nihongo|'''Saori Izawa'''|伊澤彩織|Izawa Saori|lead=yes|born February 16, 1994}} is a Japanese [[actress]] and [[stunt performer]], known for her role as Mahiro Fukagawa in the ''[[Baby Assassins]]'' film series.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Volk |first=Pete |date=2024-04-04 |title=The Baby Assassins movies revive the dying art of action comedy |url=https://www.polygon.com/24120218/baby-assassins-good-action-comedy-movies-watch-streaming/ |access-date=2026-07-20 |website=Polygon.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Alvarado |first=Aryanna |date=2025-07-03 |title=10 Modern Martial Arts Stars You Should Definitely Pay Attention To |url=https://screenrant.com/martial-arts-stars-recent-list/ |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=ScreenRant |language=en}}</ref>

Izawa was born in [[Saitama Prefecture]], [[Japan]], on February 16, 1994. She graduated from the Department of [[Film studies|Film Studies]] at [[Nihon University|Nihon University of Art]] <sub>[<nowiki/>[[:ja:日本大学芸術学部・大学院芸術学研究科|ja]]]</sub> in [[Tokyo]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=365 ANNIVERSARY CALENDAR 今日は何の日？ 〜11/3〜 |url=https://www.nylon.jp/365/2025/1103 |access-date=2026-07-13 |website=NYLON JAPAN}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=俳優・山田孝之さん　やりたいことをやれば、自分がアップデートされていく |url=https://www.asahi.com/sdgs/article/15577556}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=スタントウーマン伊澤彩織、女性にアクションが求められる作品を 夢は女性版仮面ライダー - 芸能 : 日刊スポーツ |url=https://www.nikkansports.com/entertainment/news/202209280000921.html |access-date=2026-07-18 |website=nikkansports.com |language=ja}}</ref>

In 2016, Izawa auditioned and was accepted as an action [[trainee]] for the movie [[Re:Born (film)|''RE:BORN'']] (2017).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Cast {{!}} The official site "RE:BORN" Director Yuji Shimomura {{!}} Cast TAK∴(TAK Sakaguchi),Issei Ishida REBORN |url=https://udenflameworks.com/reborn/en/cast.html |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=udenflameworks.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-08-02 |title=アクションはもちろん、キャラも愛せる伊澤彩織の主演映画『ベイビーわるきゅーれ』公開！ {{!}} 芸能エンタメ情報サイト＆WEBバラエティ番組制作『TrenVe』(トレンヴィ) |url=https://trenve.com/actress/25195 |access-date=2026-07-18 |language=ja}}</ref> After that, she started performing [[Stunt|stunts]] in Japanese films such as ''[[Rurouni Kenshin: The Beginning]]'' (2021) and ''[[Rurouni Kenshin: The Final]]'' (2021), as well as international films like ''[[Snake Eyes: G.I. Golden |date=2022-09-17 |title=Now On Hi-YAH!: Hugo Sakamoto's A JANITOR Paints By Bloody Numbers With A Solid Assassin Crime Thriller |url=https://filmcombatsyndicate.com/now-on-hi-yah-hugo-sakamotos-a-janitor-paints-by-bloody-numbers-with-a-solid-assassin-crime-thriller/ |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=Film Combat Syndicate |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=「髙石あかり」＆「伊澤彩織」がW主演のハードアクション作『ベイビーわるきゅーれ』。「2面性のギャップと、近接アクションを見てくださーい」 - Stereo Sound ONLINE |url=https://online.stereosound.co.jp/_ct/17469646? |archive-url=http://web.archive.org/web/20251207042038/https://online.stereosound.co.jp/_ct/17469646? |archive-date=2025-12-07 |access-date=2026-07-18 |language=en}}</ref> The movie ''[[Baby Assassins (film)|Baby Assassins]]'', starring Izawa and Takaishi, premiered in 2021 to great success and became the first of a [[Baby Assassins|series of films]]. '''Miguel Ángel Cano Mellado''' (born 23 July 1999), also known mononymously as '''Mellado''', is a Spanish professional futsal player who plays as a defender for [[FS Cartagena|Jimbee Cartagena]] and the [[Spain national futsal team|Spain national team]].

==Club career==
Originally from [[Blanca, Murcia|Blanca]], Mellado began in the youth sector of [[ElPozo Murcia]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.laverdad.es/deportes/futbol-sala-cartagena/mellado-moda-futbol-20201112001102-ntvo.html|title=Mellado, de moda en el fútbol sala, pasa de la oscuridad a brillar con España|language=es|date=12 November 2020|author=Rubén Serrano}}</ref> Following a serious injury, he then moved to that of the modest Librilla.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/futbol-sala/2021/09/18/6145f9edca47411a568b456c.html|title=Mellado, mundialista y presidente a los 22 años|language=es|date=18 September 2021|author=Óscar García}}</ref> In the 2017-18 season he was added to the first team with which he made his debut in the Spanish third division.<ref name=cartagena>{{cite web|url=https://www.sportcartagena.es/articulo/fc-cartagena/jimbee-mellado-contrato-2024/20181108191045072640.html|title=Jimbee Cartagena alcanza un acuerdo de renovación con el jugador Mellado hasta junio de 2024|language=es|date=8 November 2018}}</ref> 

In the summer of 2018, Mellado was purchased by [[FS Cartagena|Cartagena]] as a reinforcement for their youth team. However, the qualities and personality of the defender immediately convinced the coach Juan Giménez to employ him permanently in the first team, playing in the [[Primera División de Futsal|Primera División]].<ref name=cartagena/> In the following seasons Mellado's performances improved to such an extent that he earned the recognition of "revelation player" of the 2020-21 season and established himself as one of the best defenders in the Spanish championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lnfs.es/noticia/mellado-jugador-revelacion-de-la-temporada-2021/61798|title=Mellado, "Jugador Revelación" de la Temporada 20/21|language=es|date=28 July 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rfef.es/futbol-sala/noticias/mellado-conquista-del-futuro-del-futbol-sala-espanol|title=Mellado, a la conquista del futuro del futbol sala español|language=es|date=3 January 2021}}</ref>

==International career==
On 5 November 2020, Mellado made his debut for the [[Spain national futsal team|Spain national team]] during a 2-1 friendly win against [[Brazil national futsal team|Brazil]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sefutbol.com/saura-y-mellado-deseando-debutar-y-hacerse-hueco-seleccion|title=Saura y Mellado, deseando debutar y hacerse un hueco en la Selección|language=es|date=2 November 2020|access-date=8 February 2022|archive-date=8 February 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220208122543/https://www.sefutbol.com/saura-y-mellado-deseando-debutar-y-hacerse-hueco-seleccion|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/masdeporte/2020/11/05/polideportivo/1604610443_677295.html|title=La estrategia da a La Roja su primer triunfo ante Brasil en 10 años|language=es|date=5 November 2022|author=Mario de la Riva}}</ref> On 30 August 2021, he was included in the final list of players called up for the [[2021 FIFA Futsal World Cup|2021 World Cup]], which Spain reached the quarter-finals.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/futbol-sala/2021/08/30/612c9d9346163f76248b456d.html|title=España ya tiene sus 16 convocados para el Mundial|language=es|date=30 August 2021|author=Óscar García}}</ref> On 28 December 2021, he was included in the list of players called up for the [[UEFA Futsal Euro 2022]].<ref>{{cite web|access-date=8 February 2022 |archive-date=24 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220124114943/https://www.sefutbol.com/oficial-estos-son-convocados-seleccion-absoluta-futbol-sala-eurocopa |date=31 December 2021 |language=es |title=Estos son los convocados de la Selección Absoluta de Fútbol Sala para la Eurocopa |url=https://www.sefutbol.com/oficial-estos-son-convocados-seleccion-absoluta-futbol-sala-eurocopa |url-status=dead}}<!-- auto-translated from Italian by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> 

Four years later, Mellado was part of the Spanish team that won its eighth continental title at the [[UEFA Futsal Euro 2026|UEFA Futsal Euro]] in which he was included in the team of the tournament.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://it.uefa.com/futsaleuro/news/02a2-1fdf1b047fd6-346089e7ed31-1000--finale-uefa-futsal-euro-2026-portogallo-spagna-3-5/|title=Finale UEFA Futsal EURO 2026: Portogallo - Spagna 3-5|date=7 February 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|date=17 February 2026 |title=La squadra del torneo di futsal EURO 2026 |url=https://it.uefa.com/futsaleuro/news/02a2-1fe22f812c0f-43cb72894d7d-1000--la-squadra-del-torneo-di-futsal-euro-2026/}}<!-- auto-translated from Italian by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>

==Career==
Ytterhus Haugset had a strong start to the 2025 season before missing two months due to crashing at [[2025 Paris–Roubaix Femmes|Paris–Roubaix]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Broken hip setback for Sigrid Ytterhus Haugset after promising spring campaign |url=https://procyclinguk.com/broken-hip-setback-for-sigrid-ytterhus-haugset-after-promising-spring-campaign/ |website=ProCyclingUk |access-date=31 July 2026}}</ref>. In 2026 she signed with [[Uno-X Mobility (women's team)|Uno-X Mobility]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Får proffdrømmen oppfylt: Klar for Uno-X |url=https://www.landevei.no/proffsykling/uno-x-pro-cycling/sigrid-ytterhus-haugset-klar-for-uno-x-mobility |website=Landevei |access-date=31 July 2026}}</ref> She made her debut for the team at Trofeo Marratxi-Felanitx, finishing fourth.

'''Presley Walker Gerber''' (July 2, 1999 – September 20, 2026) was an American model. He was the elder child of [[Cindy Crawford]] and [[Rande Gerber]] and the brother of model and actress [[Kaia Gerber]]. He began modeling as a teenager and later appeared in runway shows and advertising campaigns for several major fashion brands. He also spoke publicly about his experiences with mental health and addiction.

== Early life and education ==
Presley Walker Gerber was born in a [[home birth]]<ref>{{cite news |last=Newcomb |first=Alyssa |date=March 30, 2020 |title=Cindy Crawford shares her experience having two home births |url=https://www.today.com/parents/cindy-crawford-shares-her-experience-having-two-home-births-t177128 |access-date=September 22, 2026 |work=Today|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200425135645/https://www.today.com/parents/cindy-crawford-shares-her-experience-having-two-home-births-t177128|archive-date=April 25, 2020}}</ref> on July 2, 1999 in [[Brentwood, Los Angeles]], California, U.S.,<ref name="Lammers">{{cite news |last=Lammers |first=Tim |date=September 20, 2026 |title=Presley Gerber, Son Of Cindy Crawford And Rande Gerber, Dies At 27 |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/timlammers/2026/09/20/presley-gerber-son-of-cindy-crawford-and-rande-gerber-dies-at-27/ |access-date=September 21, 2026 |work=Forbes|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260921122228/https://www.forbes.com/sites/timlammers/2026/09/20/presley-gerber-son-of-cindy-crawford-and-rande-gerber-dies-at-27/|archive-date=September 21, 2026}}</ref> the first child and only son of supermodel [[Cindy Crawford]] and businessman [[Rande Gerber]].<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/169427896/ |title=Presley has left the building |work=[[Chicago Tribune]] |date=July 8, 1999 |access-date=September 22, 2026 |page=98 |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{Closed access}}</ref> He had a younger sister, [[Kaia Gerber|Kaia]].<ref name="Lammers" /> He graduated from [[Malibu High School]] in 2017.<ref>{{cite news |last=Aiello |first=McKenna |date=June 9, 2017 |title=Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber Celebrate Son Presley Gerber's High School Graduation |url=https://www.eonline.com/news/859999/cindy-crawford-and-rande-gerber-celebrate-son-presley-gerber-s-high-school-graduation |access-date=September 21, 2026 |work=E! News|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170613125318/https://www.eonline.com/news/859999/cindy-crawford-and-rande-gerber-celebrate-son-presley-gerber-s-high-school-graduation|archive-date=June 13, 2017}}</ref> 

Gerber's parents said the name Presley came from a dinner with record producer [[David Foster]], who was then married to [[Linda Thompson]], formerly [[Elvis Presley]]'s girlfriend. They recalled Foster asking, "Can you imagine being me, having to follow Presley?" and that the name stuck.<ref>{{cite news |last=Widdicombe |first=Ben |date=January 26, 2018 |title=When Beefcake Ages Very Nicely |url=https://www.wral.com/archive/17292530/ |access-date=October 1, 2026 |work=The New York Times}}</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
In January 2019,<ref>{{cite magazine |last=Frey |first=Kaitlyn |date=January 2, 2019 |title=Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber's Son Presley Gerber, 19, Charged with DUI |url=https://people.com/style/presley-gerber-arrested-for-dui/ |access-date=September 21, 2026 |work=People |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/jO3W2 |archive-date=September 21, 2026}}</ref> Gerber was arrested and charged with [[driving under the influence]] (DUI). He received three years' probation and was required to complete a DUI program and two days of [[community service]].<ref>{{cite news |last=Nordyke |first=Kimberly |date=September 20, 2026 |title=Presley Gerber, Son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, Dies at 27 |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/lifestyle-news/presley-gerber-dead-cindy-crawford-rande-gerber-kaia-gerber-1236706714/ |access-date=September 21, 2026 |work=The Hollywood Reporter|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260921124910/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/lifestyle-news/presley-gerber-dead-cindy-crawford-rande-gerber-kaia-gerber-1236706714/|archive-date=September 21, 2026}}</ref>

In 2020, he tattooed his face with the word "misunderstood" under his eye, which led to viral controversy.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-02-11 |title=Cindy Crawford's son defends his surprising new face tattoo |url=https://www.today.com/popculture/cindy-crawford-s-son-defends-face-tattoo-t173668 |access-date=2026-09-25 |website=TODAY.com |language=en |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260922032004/https://www.today.com/popculture/cindy-crawford-s-son-defends-face-tattoo-t173668 |archive-date=September 22, 2026 |url-status=live}}</ref> Gerber compared the negative comments to [[transphobia]] in a later post.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Manning |first=Charles |date=2020-03-12 |title=Presley Gerber Compares His Face Tattoo to Changing Genders |url=https://fashionweekdaily.com/presley-gerber-face-tattoo-transphobia/ |access-date=2026-09-25 |website=Daily Front Row |language=en |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260922113043/https://fashionweekdaily.com/presley-gerber-face-tattoo-transphobia/ |archive-date=September 22, 2026 |url-status=live}}</ref> According to ''[[People (magazine)|People]]'', he had removed it by August 2021.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Garner |first=Glenn |date=August 10, 2021 |title=Presley Gerber Seems to Have Removed His 'Misunderstood' Face Tattoo a Year After Ink's Debut |url=https://people.com/style/presley-gerber-removed-his-misunderstood-face-tattoo/ |access-date=September 25, 2026 |work=People}}</ref>

In 2023, Gerber discussed his experiences with mental health on the Studio 22 [[podcast]]. He said he had dealt with depression and related issues, and added that "whether I help one person or a hundred people get out of that place ... that's all I need to do."<ref>{{cite news |last=Graham |first=Chris |date=September 21, 2026 |title=Presley Gerber, Cindy Crawford's son, dies aged 27 |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmdx0pqrv72wo |access-date=September 21, 2026 |work=BBC News|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260921103908/https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cmdx0pqrv72wo|archive-date=September 21, 2026}}</ref> On the podcast, he also mentioned considering a mental health‑focused clothing line.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Etienne |first=Vanessa |date=March 2, 2023 |title=Presley Gerber Wants to Raise Mental Health Awareness After Struggling with Depression |url=https://people.com/health/presley-gerber-raising-mental-health-awareness-after-therapy/ |access-date=September 25, 2026 |work=People}}</ref> The same year, Gerber began an Instagram series called "Mental Health Mondays", where he discussed his experiences with depression and addiction.<ref>{{cite news |last=Suliman |first=Adela |date=September 21, 2026 |title=Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford, dies at 27 |url=https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/presley-gerber-son-cindy-crawford-dies-27-rcna598952 |access-date=September 21, 2026 |work=NBC News|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260921142633/https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/presley-gerber-son-cindy-crawford-dies-27-rcna598952|archive-date=September 21, 2026}}</ref> On the series, he said he first saw a psychiatrist at around 13 and began taking [[Xanax]] at 16, which initially helped before he started to worry about its long‑term effects. He said he knew what dependence and addiction were but did not realise he was moving in that direction.<ref name="GerberNYT" /> He described being treated with several medications over the years, including [[Prozac]] at 14 for anxiety and panic attacks. Gerber said he first went to rehab in his late teens, where he was given [[trazodone]], an antidepressant that he said left him feeling numb.<ref name="GerberNYT" /> He was prescribed other drugs during multiple rehab stays, the first at 18 or 19, and mentioned using [[ketamine]] and [[kratom]] to manage withdrawal symptoms. He also recalled taking [[Valium]], [[Adderall]] and [[buprenorphine]] before becoming dissatisfied with medication and traditional rehab programs.<ref name="GerberNYT">{{cite news |last=McKinley |first=Jesse |date=October 6, 2026 |title=For Years, Presley Gerber Documented His Own Struggles, in His Own Words |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/06/style/presley-gerber-death-cindy-crawford.html |url-access=subscription |access-date=October 12, 2026 |work=The New York Times}}</ref> 

In March 2026, he posted a video showing him preparing for a "pre‑[[ibogaine]] flood dose" in [[Cancún|Cancun]], Mexico.<ref>{{cite news |last=O'Grady |first=Sean |date=September 21, 2026 |title=Presley Gerber had psychedelic drug treatment in Mexico just months before he died |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/fashion/presley-gerber-kaia-death-drugs-b3053506.html |access-date=September 21, 2026 |work=The Independent|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260921131044/https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/fashion/presley-gerber-kaia-death-drugs-b3053506.html|archive-date=September 21, 2026}}</ref> In June 2026, Gerber took part in a mental-health event in [[Malibu, California|Malibu]]. He spoke about his experiences with mental health, including a turning point at age 23 and the pressures of growing up in the public eye, and said he felt more free after being open about what he had gone through.<ref>{{cite magazine |last=Durkan |first=Deirdre |date=September 21, 2026 |title=Presley Gerber Appeared Alongside Parents Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber in Last Public Appearance 3 Months Before His Death |url=https://people.com/presley-gerber-appeared-alongside-parents-cindy-crawford-rande-gerber-last-public-appearance-months-before-death-12131263 |access-date=September 21, 2026 |work=People|archive-date=September 22, 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260922091126/https://people.com/presley-gerber-appeared-alongside-parents-cindy-crawford-rande-gerber-last-public-appearance-months-before-death-12131263}}</ref>

Gerber died at Resolutions Living, a rehabilitation facility in [[Santa Monica, California]], one day after he arrived,<ref>{{cite news |last=Winton |first=Richard |date=September 26, 2026 |title=Inside the ultra-luxury sober living home where Presley Gerber died of suspected overdose |url=https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2026-09-26/inside-ultra-luxury-sober-living-home-where-cindy-crawfords-son-presley-gerber-died |access-date=October 12, 2026 |work=Los Angeles Times}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Pizzimenti |first=Chiara |date=October 11, 2026 |title=George Clooney Is Mourning Presley Gerber: "It's The Worst Thing” |url=https://www.vanityfair.com/story/george-clooney-presley-gerber |url-access=subscription |access-date=October 12, 2026 |work=Vanity Fair}}</ref> on September 20, 2026, at age 27.<ref>{{cite news |last=Sands |first=Leo |date=September 21, 2026 |title=Presley Gerber, Model and Son of Cindy Crawford, Dies at 27 |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/21/obituaries/presley-gerber-dead-cindy-crawford.html |url-access=subscription |access-date=September 21, 2026 |work=The New York Times}}</ref>

'''Alessandro Lana''' (born 20 March 1986) is an Italian politician who served as president of the [[Province of Verbano-Cusio-Ossola]] from 2021 to 2025.<ref>{{cite news |title=Provincia, congedo tra gli applausi per il presidente Alessandro Lana |url=https://www.lastampa.it/verbano-cusio-ossola/2025/11/28/news/provincia_vco_ultimo_consiglio_presidente_lana-15414988/ |work=[[La Stampa]] |date=28 November 2025 |last=Pastore |first=Cristina}}</ref> He has served as mayor of [[Piedimulera]] since 2014.<ref name=interno/><ref>{{cite web |title=Comune di Piedimulera - Piemonte - Elezioni Comunali - 25 maggio 2014 |url=https://www.repubblica.it/static/speciale/2014/elezioni/comunali/piedimulera.html |work=[[la Repubblica]] |date=26 May 2014}}</ref>

Lana was elected [[president of the Province of Verbano-Cusio-Ossola]] as a [[Centre-right coalition (Italy)|centre-right candidate]] in December 2021, defeating Marco Stefanetta, mayor of [[Vogogna]], with 50,819 weighted votes.<ref>{{cite news |title=Provincia del Vco al voto per eleggere il nuovo presidente |url=https://www.lastampa.it/verbano-cusio-ossola/2021/12/18/news/provincia_del_vco_al_voto_per_eleggere_il_nuovo_presidente-1733974/ |work=[[La Stampa]] |date=18 December 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Alessandro Lana nuovo presidente della Provincia di Verbania |url=https://www.novaratoday.it/zone/verbano-cusio-ossola/alessandro-lana-nuovo-presidente-provincia-verbania.html |work=NovaraToday}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Alessandro Lana è il nuovo presidente della Provincia del Vco. Ecco il nuovo Consiglio |url=https://www.lastampa.it/verbano-cusio-ossola/2021/12/19/news/alessandro_lana_e_il_nuovo_presidente_della_provincia_del_vco-1789352/ |work=[[La Stampa]] |date=19 December 2021}}</ref> In March 2025 he also became president of the [[Union of Italian Provinces|UPI Piedmont]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Alessandro Lana eletto presidente delle Province piemontesi |url=https://www.lastampa.it/verbano-cusio-ossola/2025/03/02/news/alessandro_lana_presidente_province_piemontesi-15030854/ |work=[[La Stampa]] |date=2 March 2025}}</ref>
